```python
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pyscf import gto, dft
s='C#CC1=CC(=O)CCN1'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(s))
status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=17)
print('RDKit embedding status:',status)
if status == 0:
 AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=500)
 conf=m.GetConformer()
 atoms=[]
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
  atoms.append(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.8f} {p.y:.8f} {p.z:.8f}')
 mol=gto.M(atom='; '.join(atoms), basis='6-31g*', charge=0, spin=0, verbose=0)
 mf=dft.RKS(mol)
 mf.xc='B3LYP'
 mf.conv_tol=1e-9
 e=mf.kernel()
 eps=mf.mo_energy
 occ=mf.mo_occ
 homo=max(eps[occ>0]); lumo=min(eps[occ==0])
 print('SMILES:',s)
 print('Method: B3LYP/6-31G*, single point on RDKit MMFF-minimized conformer')
 print('SCF converged:',mf.converged,'Total energy (Ha):',e)
 print('HOMO (Ha):',float(homo))
 print('LUMO (Ha):',float(lumo))
 print('Gap (Ha):',float(lumo-homo))
else:
 print('No geometry generated')
```
